summary: Customer reported a duplicate charge on their credit card.

intents.keywords: Arvind charged voice on my ... happens this time.
issues: Duplicate charge of $5200 from a restaurant on the credit card statement.
reasons (identified by agent): System error resulting in the same transaction being processed twice.
actions of agent: Agent flagged the issue for a refund.
Agent provided a timeframe of 5-7 business days for the refund to reflect.
Agent promised to keep the customer updated.
intents.resolution: Chargeback request initiated; refund pending in 5-7 business days.
intents.agent professionalism: Agent remained calm and professional despite customer's frustration.
